verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs describe first-party commands to scaffold a first agent and a general-purpose agent harness. That points to an official command-line entry point, but the evidence never names the CLI or describes its command set. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official CLI with documented commands (e.g., dev/build/deploy), AI-native or agent-driven CLI workflows beyond project scaffolding, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create your first agent with a single command and start building.
Run this command to create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules.
